title: 16.75. Sanidassanattika, Upādāduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Anidassanaappaṭighaṁ upādā dhammaṁ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho noupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Anidassanasappaṭighaṁ noupādā dhammaṁ paṭicca naanidassanasappaṭigho nanoupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … cha.
Anidassanaappaṭighaṁ noupādā dhammaṁ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho nanoupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … cha.
Anidassanasappaṭighaṁ noupādā ca anidassanaappaṭighaṁ noupādā ca dhammaṁ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho nanoupādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … cha. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā aṭṭhārasa, adhipatiyā aṭṭhārasa …pe… avigate aṭṭhārasa.
